caveats: Sources are reported separately and must not be pooled into one headline number.
ring_playground has N=2 and its frames were seen in the 2026-10-15 smoke test.
synthetic_overlay images are composites; they test counting and label reading, not realism.
Carrier accuracy exists only where carrier truth exists (synthetic_overlay).
Latency is wall clock per call, run sequentially from one client, including a retry.
The two models run with different output modes (see models[].structured_output).

post_hoc_diagnosis.finding: On synthetic_overlay porch composites (n=20) both models mostly undercount by exactly 1. Their reasoning shows they count only the pasted, labelled boxes and ignore the unlabelled box already on the step from the Playground footage (base_count=1). On driveway composites (base_count=0, n=16) exact match was 9/16 (Nova Pro) and 15/16 (Sonnet 4.6). Labels were not changed after seeing results.
